# Clean Label Project

> Independent third-party testing and certification organization ensuring product safety, purity, and transparency through rigorous contaminant testing and quality assurance standards.

Clean Label Project provides consumers and manufacturers with verified product safety information through its CLP Certification program, mobile app, and comprehensive testing across food and supplement categories. The organization combines laboratory testing, transparency initiatives, and industry standards to combat contamination from heavy metals, pesticides, and chemical additives.

## Key Topics

- CLP Certification
- Heavy metals testing
- Contaminant detection
- Product safety
- Third-party testing
- Purity Award
- Clean-16 standards
- Food safety
- Consumer transparency
- ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation
- Pesticides
- BPA and phthalates
- Acrylamide
- Quality assurance
- Certified products database

## Core Organization

- [Home Page](https://cleanlabelproject.org): Clean Label Project homepage introducing organization and CLP Mobile App
- [About](https://cleanlabelproject.org/about): Organization mission, transparency, and food safety overview
- [What We Do](https://cleanlabelproject.org/what-we-do): CLP certification, contaminant testing, and Clean-16 list standards
- [Leadership](https://cleanlabelproject.org/leadership): Board of directors and executive team including Molly Hamilton

## Certification & Products

- [CLP Certification Process](https://cleanlabelproject.org/clp-certification-process): CLP certification requirements, application, and compliance procedures
- [Certified Products Directory](https://cleanlabelproject.org/certified-products): Searchable brand directory of certified products with safety data
- [The Certified Products](https://cleanlabelproject.org/the-certified-products): Directory of certified products meeting safety and purity standards
- [Awards & Certifications](https://cleanlabelproject.org/awards-certifications): Purity Award, ISO 17025, and certification program overview

## Mobile App & Tools

- [Clean Label Project App](https://cleanlabelproject.org/app): CLP Mobile App for product safety data, purity ratings, and Purity+AI

## Research & Testing Studies

- [Category Testing](https://cleanlabelproject.org/category-testing): Product category studies on contamination in proteins, snacks, coffee
- [Protein Study 2.0](https://cleanlabelproject.org/protein-study-2-0): Protein powder contaminant analysis including heavy metals and BPA
- [Snack and Nutrition Study](https://cleanlabelproject.org/snack-and-nutrition-study): Snack bar nutrition and heavy metals testing research findings
- [Coffee Study](https://cleanlabelproject.org/coffee-study): Coffee product testing for pesticides and heavy metal contamination
- [Pediatric OTC Study](https://cleanlabelproject.org/pediatric-otc-study): OTC medication testing for phthalates and chemical contaminants
- [Transparency Project](https://cleanlabelproject.org/transparency-project): Puori supplement testing and third-party quality assurance results

## Testing Standards & Reference

- [Trusted 10](https://cleanlabelproject.org/trusted-10): Lab testing standards, ISO/IEC 17025, and analytical methods guide
- [Technical Administrator](https://cleanlabelproject.org/technical-administrator): Ellipse Analytics as technical administrator for certification programs
- [Product Recalls](https://cleanlabelproject.org/product-recalls): FDA and USDA-FSIS product recalls for food safety and contamination

## Support & Resources

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://cleanlabelproject.org/frequently-asked-questions-faq): Testing methodology, certification, and laboratory accreditation FAQs
